content.title: Leyden Rock Underpass Mural
content.summary: The Leyden Rock Underpass Mural, a public art initiative by the City of Arvada's Arts and Culture Commission, was completed by artist Graham Carraway in November 2025. Located at the underpass along the Barbara Gulch Trail near the intersection of Leyden Rock Dr. and W. 82nd Ave., the mural showcases local flora and fauna, celebrating the area's history and ecosystem.
content.body:
![Bright mural with bold yellow flowers and dark leaves on a red and turquoise background.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6811 "Bright mural with bold yellow flowers and dark leaves on a red and turquoise background.")

The Leyden Rock Underpass Mural is a public art project led by the City of Arvada's [Arvada Arts and Culture Commission](/488). This project began with a resident proposal and advanced through an open call for Colorado-based artists. Artist Graham Carraway completed the mural in November 2025.

### Mural Location

The mural is located at the underpass along the Barbara Gulch Trail, [just east of the Leyden Rock Dr. and W. 82nd Ave. intersection](https://maps.app.goo.gl/y79Mwsftw85RLtWr7) in northwest Arvada.

> [View this post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DR5iHJ9j3Jr/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)
>
> [A post shared by City of Arvada (@cityofarvada)](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DR5iHJ9j3Jr/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)

### South End Facing South

![Colorful mural-lined path curving through an underpass in a dry, open landscape.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6812 "Colorful mural-lined path curving through an underpass in a dry, open landscape.")

![Mural of a vibrant hummingbird flying beside large yellow flowers and abstract shapes.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6813 "Mural of a vibrant hummingbird flying beside large yellow flowers and abstract shapes.")

![Mural of pink and white blossoming trees against bold, colorful abstract shapes.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6814 "Mural of pink and white blossoming trees against bold, colorful abstract shapes.")

### South End Facing North

![Painted underpass wall with bright color blocks lining a curved concrete pathway.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6815 "Painted underpass wall with bright color blocks lining a curved concrete pathway.")

## About the Artist

[Denver-based Artist Graham Carraway](https://jgrahamstudios.com/) was selected for the project to install a mural that features local flora and fauna while celebrating the history, beauty and ecosystem of the area.

Carraway's work specializes in producing mural imagery through printmaking with hand-carved blocks, which adds a distinct and captivating dimension to his designs.

### [Artist stands by a colorful flower mural inside an underpass, wearing paint-splattered clothes. Do](https://jgrahamstudios.com/)

### Project Timeline

Carraway began installing the mural in September 2025 and completed it in November 2025.
